meta.scope: Taiwan Batch 16 — Environmental, cultural/language, local fiscal, and further dual-use/location densification. Continues the dig into air quality, language use and status, county/city fiscal and taxable-income statistics, and tighter spatial links for dual-use and high-tech location.
meta.strategy_note: User request to keep going on environmental, cultural/language, more precise dual-use location, deeper local fiscal, etc.

candidates.title: Air quality and air-pollution statistics (AQI, PM2.5, pollutant concentrations)
candidates.description: Official statistics on Air Quality Index, PM2.5 and other pollutant concentrations, major sources, inspections and control fees. Series exist at national and county/city level; eastern counties (Taitung, Hualien) typically show the best readings while western industrial and urban areas are more stressed.
candidates.notes: Core environmental monitoring series with clear spatial variation that maps onto the industrial geography.

candidates.title: Language-use statistics (Mandarin, Hoklo/Taiwanese, Hakka, Indigenous languages)
candidates.publisher: Ministry of Education / Hakka Affairs Council / Council of Indigenous Peoples / survey-based official and quasi-official sources
candidates.description: Statistics and surveys on home and public use of Mandarin, Hoklo (Taiwanese), Hakka and Indigenous languages. Document the long-term shift toward Mandarin, higher retention of local languages in older cohorts and in southern/central areas, and official efforts to reverse decline.
candidates.notes: Cultural-identity statistical layer. Complements the Indigenous demographic nodes and adds a linguistic dimension to social dualism and regional difference.

candidates.title: Hakka language and Hakka Affairs Council framework
candidates.description: Institutional and statistical products of the Hakka Affairs Council and the legal status of Hakka as a national language. Tracks speaker numbers, geographic strongholds, and language-revitalisation programmes.
candidates.notes: Parallel institutional node to the Council of Indigenous Peoples for another major identity/language community.

candidates.title: National languages legal and policy framework (Mandarin, Hoklo, Hakka, Indigenous)
candidates.publisher: Legislative Yuan / Executive Yuan / related councils
candidates.description: Legal recognition of multiple national languages and the associated policy architecture for education, broadcasting and public services. Recurring citation in cultural and education policy.
candidates.notes: Foundational recurring-citation node for the cultural/language cluster.

candidates.title: County and city consolidated taxable income / tax statistics
candidates.publisher: Fiscal Information Agency, Ministry of Finance / National Taxation Bureau
candidates.description: Official statistics on consolidated taxable income and related tax aggregates reported by county and city. Provide a fiscal counterpart to the household disposable-income rankings and reveal the spatial concentration of taxable capacity.
candidates.notes: Deeper local fiscal node. Directly links the high-tech geography to the spatial distribution of taxable capacity.

candidates.title: Local government finance and special-account / fund statistics
candidates.publisher: Ministry of Finance / Directorate-General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics / local governments
candidates.description: Statistics on local government budgets, funds and special accounts by level (special municipalities vs counties/cities). Quantify the fiscal resources available to the major municipal nodes versus peripheral counties.
candidates.notes: Institutional fiscal densification of the sub-national layer.

candidates.title: Dual-use and defence-industrial location patterns (science parks, shipyards, southern corridor)
candidates.publisher: Derived from MND, MOEA, NSTC and local industrial statistics
candidates.region: Especially western and southern industrial zones
candidates.description: Spatial patterning of dual-use and defence-relevant capacity: concentration of advanced electronics and materials in science parks (Hsinchu core and southern expansion), naval shipbuilding and related yards, and the co-location pressures that arise when commercial high-tech and defence requirements share the same constrained land, water and talent pools.
referenced_by: Indigenous naval shipbuilding and defence-industry nodes
candidates.notes: More precise spatial densification of the dual-use edge requested by the user.

candidates.title: Local environmental quality variation (air, water, waste) by region
candidates.publisher: Ministry of Environment / local Environmental Protection Bureaus
candidates.description: County- and city-level environmental quality indicators that reveal systematic east–west and urban–industrial gradients. Complements the national air-quality and water-resources series with explicit spatial resolution.
candidates.notes: Spatial environmental densification that maps onto the same core–periphery structure as income and industry.

candidates.title: Cultural and language institutional statistics (Hakka Affairs Council, Council of Indigenous Peoples, cultural budgets)
candidates.publisher: Hakka Affairs Council / Council of Indigenous Peoples / Ministry of Culture
candidates.description: Budget, programme and output statistics of the principal cultural and language institutions. Provide the organisational backbone for the language-revitalisation and Indigenous/Hakka policy clusters.
candidates.notes: Institutional densification of the cultural cluster.

candidates.title: Environmental–cultural–local-fiscal densification meta-node
candidates.publisher: Derived from MOENV, language councils, MOF and related sources
candidates.description: Meta-node that records the further densification of environmental quality (air, local gradients), cultural/language (use statistics, Hakka and national-languages frameworks, institutional budgets), local fiscal capacity (taxable income and government finance by division), and more precise dual-use location patterns, together with their edges into the spatial, semiconductor, social and resilience clusters.
referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
Earlier sub-national, environmental, social-structure and dual-use nodes
candidates.notes: Book-keeping node for this multi-domain dig.
